**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

This APCN 2 consortium construction and maintenance agreement contains no restrictive covenant of any kind. Searches for "solicit", "employee", "personnel", "hire" and "induce" returned zero hits, and the section outline (Definitions through Entire Agreement, plus the Segment/Terminal Party schedules) contains no employment or non-solicitation provision — § 21 "Relationship of Parties" is a bare heading with no hiring restrictions attached.

That result sits at the playbook's **preferred** position: no non-solicit binding our party, and correspondingly no no-hire, duration or scope issues to negotiate. As a presence-kind rule whose preferred outcome is the absence of the clause, this is compliant rather than "missing" — nothing needs to be added, and we should not volunteer a mutual non-solicit into an agreement type where it is not customary.
